packet.title: Refine a traversal brew into a permanent site-changing wash
packet.status: source-ready research candidate; original native binding proposed, not selected or implemented
packet.delta: Same finite material can preserve personal movement or change a retained site; transformation destroys the actual hazard and leaves a substrate with a later downside. This differs from identification, temporary scent/cooling, ordinary toolcraft and ALL19 bench drying.
packet.player_decision: Use the actual precursor for one personal bypass while leaving the hazard intact, or refine it to destroy the same site hazard and retain water that changes later local charge reach and self-risk.

use.result: finite rain; allowed-ground water/trap deletion retained in Level map

source_costs.alternative: Drink base ->20 Levitation duration; flight only while buff active

packet.actual_aftermath: Used dose gone; rain depletes; allowed terrain stays water and actual trap record stays removed; map/trap/blob/energy serialized. Later lightning reads real water, not potion knowledge; wand charge and actor damage remain spent.
meaningful_failures: Mixed seed species can spend all three inputs and produce unintended potion
Custom terrain veto or unsupported rock/pit yields no water conversion
Throw into pit/well takes ordinary item path rather than shatter
Wet main lightning target expands arcs and removes damage dilution; adjacent caster can die from half damage
